# 14 · Vision & perception

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

Choosing and calibrating a camera that flies, stabilising it, detecting and tracking objects in the air, turning a pixel into a ground coordinate, and fitting the whole pipeline into a latency budget on the compute you can carry.
